image_description: A close-up, eye-level shot of a large adult common iguana perched on a thick tree branch. The iguana has greyish-green skin with darker banding, a prominent serrated dorsal crest running down its neck and back, and a large subtympanic shield below the ear. Its head is triangular with a visible dewlap, and it is looking towards the left. The background consists of blurred green foliage, indicating an arboreal environment.
